nodes.label: BaseMessage
nodes.desc: Root of the message hierarchy: content plus role metadata, serializable.

nodes.label: HumanMessage
nodes.desc: Represents user input with role 'user'.

nodes.label: AIMessage
nodes.desc: Model output: content plus tool_calls, usage metadata and response metadata.

nodes.label: AIMessageChunk
nodes.desc: Additive streaming delta; chunks concatenate into a full AIMessage.

nodes.label: BaseChatModel
nodes.desc: Abstract base every provider chat model extends; owns callbacks, caching, rate limiting.

nodes.label: invoke()
nodes.desc: Public entry point; wraps a single prompt and delegates to generate().

nodes.label: generate()
nodes.desc: Batched generation with cache lookups, callbacks and usage aggregation.

nodes.label: _generate()
nodes.desc: Abstract hook that each provider package implements to call its HTTP API.

nodes.label: stream()
nodes.desc: Default streaming loops _stream() chunks; falls back to pseudo-streaming generate().

nodes.label: init_chat_model()
nodes.desc: Lazy model constructor: parses 'provider:model' strings and imports the integration on demand.

nodes.label: _parse_model()
nodes.desc: Splits 'openai:gpt-5.5' into model name and provider, inferring provider from name prefixes.

nodes.label: Runnable
nodes.desc: Base class exposing invoke, batch, stream and the composition operators.

nodes.label: RunnableSequence
nodes.desc: Result of chain = step1 | step2; runs steps sequentially piping output to input.

nodes.label: RunnableSequence.invoke
nodes.desc: Iterates self.steps, opening a child callback run per step and piping each output forward.

nodes.label: RunnableLambda
nodes.desc: Wraps any sync/async callable so plain functions can join chains.

nodes.label: with_retry()
nodes.desc: Returns a RunnableRetry wrapper with exponential backoff for any step.

nodes.label: with_fallbacks()
nodes.desc: Returns a RunnableWithFallbacks that tries alternates on error.

nodes.label: StrOutputParser
nodes.desc: Extracts .content from a message; also streams partial strings from AIMessageChunks.

nodes.label: BaseTool
nodes.desc: Runnable subclass representing a callable the model can request by name.

nodes.label: BaseTool.run()
nodes.desc: Validates args against args_schema, handles callbacks and errors, then dispatches to _run.

nodes.label: StructuredTool
nodes.desc: Builds a tool from any function plus a Pydantic args_schema (or inferred via from_function).

nodes.label: create_agent()
nodes.desc: Public factory: builds a tool-calling loop graph, wired with middleware and structured output.

nodes.label: init_chat_model(model)
nodes.desc: When model is a string like 'openai:gpt-5.5', the factory resolves it to a chat model instance.

nodes.label: StateGraph(AgentState)
nodes.desc: The loop is a LangGraph state machine whose state is the message list plus middleware fields.

nodes.label: model_node()
nodes.desc: One graph node: patches messages, calls the bound model, appends AIMessage to state.

nodes.label: add_node('tools')
nodes.desc: Registers the tool node only when tools are supplied; skipped for pure chat agents.

nodes.label: ToolNode re-export
nodes.desc: Re-exports ToolNode from langgraph.prebuilt: v1 agents run on LangGraph runtime.

nodes.label: Send('tools', ...)
nodes.desc: Conditional edge: if the last AIMessage has tool_calls, Send each call to the tools node, else END.

nodes.label: AgentMiddleware
nodes.desc: Base class of composable hooks plus state/context/response generics.

nodes.label: before_model()
nodes.desc: Runs before each model call; can rewrite state (e.g. trim or summarize messages).

nodes.label: after_model()
nodes.desc: Runs after each model response; can intercept tool calls or short-circuit the loop.

nodes.label: wrap_model_call()
nodes.desc: Onion-style wrapper around the model request: edit, retry or replace the call.

nodes.label: SummarizationMiddleware
nodes.desc: Ships built-in: compresses old messages into a summary when context grows past a trigger.

nodes.label: HumanInTheLoopMiddleware
nodes.desc: Ships built-in: pauses for approve/edit/reject decisions before risky tools run.
